scene: Day 37, bright morning. A long dry concrete canal seen from slightly above, cracked mud at the bottom, high smooth walls, a fence along the top. Patch (round white head, black dot eyes, orange bandage on the forehead, orange backpack, a big wooden crate strapped on top of the backpack, a big wrench in his mitten hand) walks along the narrow top edge of the canal wall, close to the camera, eyes huge, one sweat drop. Down in the dry canal bottom, six green walkers in torn clothes follow him in a line, arms raised toward him, unable to climb the smooth wall. Tense because one slip and he falls in with them.

Day 40 at a small concrete river dam with a huge iron gate wheel like a ship's helm on top. Patch (round white head, orange bandage on the forehead, orange backpack) and Rocio (round white head, wide-brim straw hat) push the giant wheel together with all their strength; under the iron gate, green lake water bursts out in white foam into a dry canal. In the distant dry canal, small green walkers look up. Patch's face: wide eyes, mouth open in effort. Hopeful but tense because the water is coming back.
